name: journal-psalm-27
description: A reader carrying fear into a psalm about it. The reply must bring the notes and the passage into conversation without diagnosing the reader or promising an outcome.

notes.title: Before the scan
notes.text: Waiting for the results this week. I keep telling people I am fine and then lying awake at 3am doing the maths on what each outcome means.

notes.title: Church on Sunday
notes.text: We sang about God being a fortress and I could not get the words out. I want to believe it the way the person next to me seemed to.

journalingChat.question: How do I hold onto this when I do not feel brave at all?

mustNotContain: you just need to have faith
